body:
## Story 5.10 — Narrow as residential access (the access tier)

Narrow's canon role is the **last-mile access drop**, sized so ONE subscriber's traffic never congests it. Slice 5B (E3.1), systems: catalogs `[ODN-5]`, topology (S1).

### The pick + the headroom math (acceptance 1)

`narrow.capacity_units`: **5 → 10** in `data/pipe_tiers.json` `[ODN-5]` (playtest-tunable — DATA, not code).

| | cap ≈ 2.5 u/s vs narrow | headroom |
|---|---|---|
| pre-5.10 | 5 / 2.5 | **2.0×** |
| post-5.10 | **10** / 2.5 | **4.0×** |

- The card's band is **~8–10 u/s → 3–4× headroom**; the pick is the top of the range: exactly **4.0×** (integer math: `10 × 1e6 ÷ (500 × 5) = 4000 permille`), and it aligns with the GDD M1 aspirational narrow (10) the terminology lane flagged — the shipped catalog reconciles for narrow.
- The transit read: `ceil(30/10) = 3` ticks/hop → a 2-hop residential path is 6 ticks = 300 ms ≤ email's 500 ms `latency_tol_ms` (the W5 guard the rebalance lifts; pre-5.10 narrow 5 u/s: 12 ticks = 600 ms). **Pinned** in `test_narrow_access_headroom` (3.2–4.0× band + the hop guard), so a future retune can't silently undershoot the contract.
- The **routing-cost ladder (20) is untouched** — moot on a single-path access link; the 2026-08-13 capacity-cost ruling is unchanged between routers (flows still prefer fat pipes). **Span rules unchanged** (`span_exceeds_tier` at edit — no contract change; `max_span` 10 untouched). **Every other tier untouched.** No new commands → **no LOG_VERSION bump**. Scope guard honored: the narrow capacity value ONLY.

### The honest signal (acceptance 2 — the pins)

1. **Zero own-traffic drops WITH headroom** — W10 (5.9's at-cap scenario) is re-pinned to **NARROW** access legs: a single residential sourcing at its cap over two narrow hops shows **zero drops at its own access lane**, no E9 shed at its endpoint, 350 ms avg email transit ≤ 500 ms (non-vacuous: 90 delivered). Pre-5.10 a narrow could not host this fixture (the W5 burst-latency guard); post-5.10 it can — that IS the story.
2. **The aggregation choke** — new `test_w11_aggregation_congests_shared_link`: 6+6 homes, each on its **own narrow drop**, aggregate onto **one shared standard uplink**. Over 600 ticks (seed 4243): **293 drops, every one at the shared bundle, ZERO at any narrow access bundle**; both classes deliver (the scenario is live). Congestion appears only where flows aggregate — a congested narrow now genuinely signals an undersized access link (the honest 4.1 reading).
3. Replay stays byte-identical `[E10]` (the determinism spine re-verified: `test_caps_replay_byte_identical` + the harness replay gate on all 31 demos).

### The deliberate re-bless (acceptance 3 — cause chain, the 4.3 discipline)

The tier change folds `cat.hash` → the slice boundary's legitimate re-bless. **Cause-documented, byte-proven:**

- **Fold:** `7dbddfc189670ba0 → 66c4324a06058860`.
- **Logs:** all **31 `.log.bin` files byte-verified** — they differ from HEAD ONLY in the 8-byte catalog_hash header field (the action logs are behaviorally identical: the tier changes sim output, never commands).
- **Fold-only proof (era-0/no-narrow demos):** boot's tick-1 state dump under the new code **with the old hash spliced at the fold position (bytes 33..40) hashes to the old golden tick-1 EXACTLY** (`c4ad25131a858304`) — those demos' T1 shift is the fold alone. (Cross-check: the same dump with the new hash = the harness's saved tick-1 `6c24e9cec592aece`.)
- **T2 partition:** pixels moved **only** in the 6 narrow-pipe demos (audio has no captures) — 15 frames across `ecmp_cost`, `forecast_shift` (era-0 transit 6→3 ticks/hop), `forecast_preview`, `health_lose`, `pause`, `surge`. All non-narrow demos' T2 frames are **byte-identical** (the fold does not shift pixels).
- **Re-pin ripples** (the narrow-10 base-demand dynamics shift pinned ticks — all re-read from the sim, never guessed): crisis settled-scan first-stream-shed bundle 0 → 2 (tick 25; the (a) scan still names bundle 0 at the trigger — the divergence staging is constructible again); health e16/rebreach/refill/softlock windows (the base fixture now breaches via LATENCY at ~7 — the queue's on-edge ~4 < the 6 bound at base demand); sla comments (3 ticks/hop, ~350 ms latency).
- input-parity manifests re-saved (the same fold).

### Lane note for 7.1-visual-juice (sibling, in flight)

This re-bless lands on the **pre-juice frames**; 7.1's T2 re-bless must rebase onto these (the 4.3 discipline). My files (catalogs + tests + goldens) are disjoint from 7.1's view code; both carry golden re-blesses at the same boundary — first-lander documents, the other rebases.

### Decisions & rationale

- **10 vs 8/9:** 4.0× headroom (the card's stated 3–4× band), the fastest narrow transit (3 ticks/hop), and reconciliation with the GDD M1 aspirational narrow 10. The headroom pin keeps future retunes honest (3.2–4.0×).
- **W10 fixture geometry:** re-spawned within narrow's `max_span` 10 (8-tile spans) — the old 12-tile fixture would silently reject the narrow draws (a rejected draw = a vacuous pin; the `!replay_error` guard is belt-and-braces).
- **W11 host drop is WIDE (not narrow/standard):** a content host's own uplink is not the access choke — with a standard host drop, the host's 30 u/s demand would saturate ITS drop ahead of the shared link (measured: 295 of 317 drops at the host leg — the wrong choke). The wide drop (40 u/s service ≥ 1.33/tick demand) leaves the shared standard uplink as the sole choke.
- **W11 sink spread:** 12 residentials keep sink-side concentration thin enough that even the shared link's release bursts stay under the access capacity (with 6 homes, 4/117 drops leaked onto sink legs — legitimate W6-scope congestion, but noise for the honest pin; 12 homes → 0).
- **Health e16 grace tweak:** email's in-test grace 380 → 200. The email breach is loss-driven and enters late (~186) under narrow 10; the E16 contract is the drain RATE (max-not-sum), never the grace values — the shorter grace re-creates the two-class overlap band before the streaming-driven death.
- **The base fixture's saturation premise changed:** at narrow 10 the on-edge queue stays ~4 (< the 6 bound) at base demand — the health/crisis fixtures' "saturated at base" dynamics are replaced by the latency breach (~7) + the surge-window saturation; every affected exact tick was re-read from the sim and re-pinned in the same commit.
- **No GDD edit:** the terminology-audit lane owns canon wording; the M1 reconciliation (narrow now matches the aspirational 10) is flagged here rather than edited.

### Verification

- `tools/ci-local.sh --mac`: **9/9 gates green** (lint, 192 core tests, app build, golden harness ×31 demos + replay gate, drift-rejection, preview cross-check, PP_DEBUG builds, stats replay-identity, input parity 24/24).
- Story card status line updated in `stories-v2.md` (the established pattern).
title: 5.10: narrow as the residential access tier (capacity 5 → 10) — the honest-signal pins
